scope: Synthetic directed extraction regression; no CUAD, official benchmark, independent labels, judge qualification or retrieval evaluation
arm_order: Luna both repetitions then Astra both repetitions; latency may reflect temporal/provider cache effects
retry_policy: No automatic retry; retain failures and stop. No model/corpus/prompt tuning after live start.
request_adjustments: Recorder explicitly sets effort and max_completion_tokens; server prompt/schema unchanged; actual outgoing requests retained.
matching: Distinct (chunk ID, NFC/casefold/whitespace-normalized exact source, exact relation, normalized exact target); one count for every unmatched gold triple; no substring or semantic judge credit.
source_checks: Every accepted occurrence has byte-valid evidence in canonical NFC chunk text and expected reviewed_by attribution. These lexical checks do not prove relation truth.
